comment: Extracts data from the Matroska and WebM container formats.

variables.name: FACTORY
variables.comment: Factory for {@link MatroskaExtractor} instances.

variables.name: FLAG_DISABLE_SEEK_FOR_CUES
variables.comment:
* Flag to disable seeking for cues. * *

Normally (i.e. when this flag is not set) the extractor will seek to the cues element if its * position is specified in the seek head and if it's after the first cluster. Setting this flag * disables seeking to the cues element. If the cues element is after the first cluster then the * media is treated as being unseekable.

variables.name: BLOCK_ADDITIONAL_ID_VP9_ITU_T_35
variables.comment:
* BlockAddID value for ITU T.35 metadata in a VP9 track. See also
   * https://www.webmproject.org/docs/container/.

variables.name: BLOCK_ADD_ID_TYPE_DVCC
variables.comment:
* BlockAddIdType value for Dolby Vision configuration with profile <= 7. See also
   * https://www.matroska.org/technical/codec_specs.html.

variables.name: BLOCK_ADD_ID_TYPE_DVVC
variables.comment:
* BlockAddIdType value for Dolby Vision configuration with profile > 7. See also
   * https://www.matroska.org/technical/codec_specs.html.

variables.name: SUBRIP_PREFIX
variables.comment:
* A template for the prefix that must be added to each subrip sample. * *

The display time of each subtitle is passed as {@code timeUs} to {@link * TrackOutput#sampleMetadata}. The start and end timecodes in this template are relative to * {@code timeUs}. Hence the start timecode is always zero. The 12 byte end timecode starting at * {@link #SUBRIP_PREFIX_END_TIMECODE_OFFSET} is set to a placeholder value, and must be replaced * with the duration of the subtitle. * *

Equivalent to the UTF-8 string: "1\n00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:00,000\n".

variables.name: SUBRIP_PREFIX_END_TIMECODE_OFFSET
variables.comment: The byte offset of the end timecode in {@link #SUBRIP_PREFIX}.

variables.name: SUBRIP_TIMECODE_LAST_VALUE_SCALING_FACTOR
variables.comment:
* The value by which to divide a time in microseconds to convert it to the unit of the last value
   * in a subrip timecode (milliseconds).

variables.name: SUBRIP_TIMECODE_FORMAT
variables.comment: The format of a subrip timecode.

variables.name: SSA_DIALOGUE_FORMAT
variables.comment: Matroska specific format line for SSA subtitles.

variables.name: SSA_PREFIX
variables.comment:
* A template for the prefix that must be added to each SSA sample. * *

The display time of each subtitle is passed as {@code timeUs} to {@link * TrackOutput#sampleMetadata}. The start and end timecodes in this template are relative to * {@code timeUs}. Hence the start timecode is always zero. The 12 byte end timecode starting at * {@link #SUBRIP_PREFIX_END_TIMECODE_OFFSET} is set to a placeholder value, and must be replaced * with the duration of the subtitle. * *

Equivalent to the UTF-8 string: "Dialogue: 0:00:00:00,0:00:00:00,".

variables.name: SSA_PREFIX_END_TIMECODE_OFFSET
variables.comment: The byte offset of the end timecode in {@link #SSA_PREFIX}.

variables.name: SSA_TIMECODE_LAST_VALUE_SCALING_FACTOR
variables.comment:
* The value by which to divide a time in microseconds to convert it to the unit of the last value
   * in an SSA timecode (1/100ths of a second).

variables.name: SSA_TIMECODE_FORMAT
variables.comment: The format of an SSA timecode.

variables.name: WAVE_FORMAT_SIZE
variables.comment: The length in bytes of a WAVEFORMATEX structure.

variables.name: WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE
variables.comment: Format tag indicating a WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure.

variables.name: WAVE_FORMAT_PCM
variables.comment: Format tag for PCM.

variables.name: WAVE_SUBFORMAT_PCM
variables.comment: Sub format for PCM.

variables.name: TRACK_NAME_TO_ROTATION_DEGREES
variables.comment: Some HTC devices signal rotation in track names.

variables.name: nalStartCode
variables.comment: Temporary arrays.

variables.name: currentTrack
variables.comment: The track corresponding to the current TrackEntry element, or null.

variables.name: sentSeekMap
variables.comment: Whether a seek map has been sent to the output.

variables.name: seekEntryId
variables.comment: Master seek entry related elements.

variables.name: seekForCues
variables.comment: Cue related elements.

variables.name: haveOutputSample
variables.comment: Reading state.

variables.name: blockState
variables.comment: Block reading state.

variables.name: sampleBytesRead
variables.comment: Sample writing state.

variables.name: extractorOutput
variables.comment: Extractor outputs.
